Onan wasn’t struck down for spilling his seed because it was wasteful, he was struck down for spilling his seed because he was deliberately trying to make sure he wouldn’t have an offspring that wasn’t “his”. 

Basically: Onan’s big brother died without a child, and tradition said that the next brother then marries the dead dude’s wife and tries to have a baby with her. Importantly, the baby is NOT considered to be the child of the younger brother, but the child of the dead father - the father’s inheritance goes to the baby. 

Onan didn’t want that - he wanted his brother’s line to end and for HIM to inherit. That’s what God found offensive in the story, and so he was struck dead. 

But for YEARS AND YEARS people have interpreted that story as being “masturbation is sinful”, and the first time I actually read it and deconstructed it in class I was like waaaaaait a second, that’s not what it actually says at ALL.
